MRO AGREEMENT

1. MAINTENANCE SERVICES
The MRO Provider shall overhaul Engine ESN-TEST-100 and deliver the serviceable engine within 30 days after acceptance.

2. PAYMENT
The Airline shall pay the fixed shop visit fee of USD 80,000 on 15 March 2027.

3. MAINTENANCE RECORDS
The MRO Provider shall provide complete shop visit records within 5 business days after redelivery.

4. LIABILITY AND INDEMNITY
The MRO Provider indemnifies the Airline for all losses arising from negligent maintenance.

5. DELAY PENALTIES
Late delivery incurs liquidated damages of EUR 100,000.

6. REGULATORY COMPLIANCE
The MRO Provider shall comply with applicable EASA requirements annually.
